# Contributing

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` before pushing. CI runs the same
command on every push and pull request against `main`.

To have this run automatically, opt into the repo's git hooks once per clone:

    git config core.hooksPath .githooks

If a change alters something a design note describes, update the note in the
same pull request. Reviewers ask for this. Starting a new note? Copy
`docs/decisions/TEMPLATE.md`.

Keep schema changes and adapter changes in separate commits when practical.

Pull requests use the checklist in `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`.
file_contents.docs/decisions/TEMPLATE.md:
# Title

Month year, context of the decision (e.g. where it was agreed).

What problem forced this decision, in concrete terms (what was breaking, for
whom).

What options were considered and why each losing option was rejected.

What was chosen and why it wins.

Any constraint under which this decision holds. State what would make this
note stop describing what the code does.
